description: This file implements a process restarter utility for the Android Open Source Project, handling process monitoring, restart logic based on signals, and subprocess execution.

methods.name: ShouldRestartProcess
methods.description: Determines whether a process should be restarted based on signal info and parser configuration.

methods.name: ExecutableShortName
methods.description: Extracts the short executable name from a full path.

methods.name: OptionsForExecutable
methods.description: Generates subprocess options for a given executable name, including strace configuration if applicable.

methods.name: RunProcessRestarter
methods.description: Main logic for running the process restarter, handling process monitoring, restart conditions, and exit status.
